$comment: Product metafield definitions the app blocks read. Create these in Shopify Admin > Settings > Custom data > Products (or via the Admin API / `shopify app` metafield tooling). Namespace is `custom`. These make each product's fit-check and facts editable by the merchant with NO code.

definitions.name: Fit-check goals
definitions.description: Optional per-product override of the fit-check goal options: [{"value":"stress","label":"Stress & feeling calmer"}, ...]. Leave empty to use the default set.

definitions.name: Safety note
definitions.description: Product-specific safety / contraindication line shown near the buy box and in the fit-check.

definitions.name: Extract name
definitions.description: e.g. 'KSM-66® Ashwagandha' — shown in the Supplement Facts block.

definitions.name: mg per serving
definitions.description: Milligrams of standardized extract per serving.

definitions.name: Certificate of Analysis URL
definitions.description: Link to the third-party heavy-metal COA shown in the Supplement Facts block.
